final: WITH account_metrics AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type IN ('PRIJEM','VYDAJ') THEN t.amount END) AS avg_credit_withdrawal_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance FROM account a JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), region_metrics AS (SELECT region, AVG(avg_credit_withdrawal_amount) AS avg_account_amount, AVG(avg_balance) AS avg_account_balance FROM account_metrics GROUP BY region) SELECT region, avg_account_amount, avg_account_balance, avg_account_amount / (SELECT AVG(avg_account_amount) FROM region_metrics) AS amount_average_divided_by_region_mean FROM region_metrics WHERE (SELECT AVG(avg_account_amount) FROM region_metrics) IS NOT NULL
